lines: Kal chaudhvin ki raat thi, shab bhar raha charcha tera.
couplets.en: The moon was full last night, and all night there was talk of you.

lines: Kuchh ne kaha ye chaand hai, kuchh ne kaha chehra tera.
couplets.en: Some said it was the moon, and some said it was your face.

lines: Hum bhi wahin maujood the, hum se bhi sab poochha kiye.
couplets.en: I was there too, and everyone kept asking me.

lines: Hum hans diye, hum chup rahe, manzoor tha parda tera.
couplets.en: I smiled and said nothing, content to keep you veiled.

lines: Is shahr mein kis se milen, hum se to chhutin mehfilen.
couplets.en: Whom can I meet in this city, now that my evenings in company are gone?

lines: Har shakhs tera naam le, har shakhs deewana tera.
couplets.en: Your name is on every tongue, and every heart is taken with you.

lines: Hum par ye sakhti ki nazar, hum hain faqir-e-rahguzar.
couplets.en: Why look so sternly on me, a beggar by the roadside?

lines: Hum par ye sakhti ki nazar, hum hain faqir-e-rahguzar.
couplets.en: Why look so sternly on me, a beggar by the roadside?

lines: Rasta kabhi roka tera, daaman kabhi thaama tera?
couplets.en: Did I ever bar your way or catch the hem of your robe?

lines: Bedard, sunni ho to chal, kehta hai kya achchhi ghazal.
couplets.en: Heartless one, come if you care to hear how well he sings a ghazal.

lines: Aashiq tera, ruswa tera, shayar tera, Insha tera.
couplets.en: Your lover, disgraced for you, your poet, your Insha.
